title: Preparation of Single-Cell Suspensions for Mass Cytometry Analysis
author: Felix J Hartmann
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bkwkkxcw

steps.title: Prepare Single-Cell Suspensions
steps.instruction: Prepare a single-cell suspension using an established method, recommending 1-3 million cells per sample. Ensure no cell aggregates remain to prevent clogging CyTOF tubing; use digestive enzymes if necessary, noting potential epitope loss.

steps.title: Prepare Small Molecule Stocks
steps.instruction: Prepare the following stocks, heating gently in a 50 °C water bath if necessary to dissolve solute, then aliquot and store at -20 °C:

steps.title: Prepare Small Molecule Mastermix
steps.instruction: Prepare a mastermix of the small molecules in cell-type appropriate medium (which may be supplemented with serum or other compounds).

steps.title: Wash Cells
steps.instruction: Transfer the cell suspension to FACS tubes or similar vessels, fill with cell-type appropriate medium (without IdU/BrU/puromycin), and centrifuge at 300 x g for 5 minutes at room temperature.

steps.title: Prepare Cisplatin-198Pt Solution
steps.instruction: Pre-dilute Cisplatin-198Pt (Fluidigm #201198, stock 100 mM) to 25 µM in PBS. For long-term use, aliquot the stock solution into 5 µL aliquots and store at -20 °C (can be thawed/refrozen multiple times). Discard pre-diluted Cisplatin after use.

steps.title: Stain for Dead Cells
steps.instruction: Aspirate the supernatant and resuspend cells in 1 mL PBS (do not use serum-containing solutions to avoid reagent sequestration).

substeps.instruction: Add 1 µL of pre-diluted Cisplatin-198Pt to the cells in PBS.
Vortex and incubate for 5 minutes at room temperature.

steps.title: Wash and De-aggregate Cells
steps.instruction: Wash the cells and ensure the pellet is fully dissolved to prevent cross-linking and acquisition problems.

substeps.instruction: Add 3 mL (or maximum vessel capacity) of Cell Staining Medium (CSM: PBS + 0.5% BSA + 0.02% sodium azide).
Centrifuge at 300 x g for 5 minutes at room temperature.
Aspirate supernatant and loosen the cell pellet by flicking the tube or vortexing.
Dilute 16% PFA (Fisher Scientific #50-980-487) to 1.6% in PBS. (Note: Opened 16% PFA can be stored airtight and light-protected for up to two weeks; discard diluted 1.6% PFA after use).
Add 1 mL of freshly diluted 1.6% PFA to loosened cells, mix well, and incubate for 10 minutes at room temperature.

steps.title: Wash and Prepare for Storage
steps.instruction: Wash the fixed cells and prepare them for freezing.

substeps.instruction: Add 3 mL (or maximum vessel capacity) of CSM and centrifuge at 600 x g for 5 minutes at 4 °C.
Aspirate supernatant and resuspend cells in 1 mL of CSM + 10% DMSO.
Transfer to a cryotube and freeze at -80 °C.

steps.title: Incubate with Mastermix
steps.instruction: Resuspend cells in 1 mL of the previously prepared mastermix and incubate at 37 °C for 30 minutes.
